meta.name: ast-grep
meta.description: Use ast-grep (sg) for AST-aware code search and rewrite across 25 languages. Trigger for structural code matching or deterministic codemods: find every function/call/class/import shaped like X, rewrite console.log to logger.info, strip `as any`, migrate require() to import, find empty catch blocks or missing await, and scan/apply YAML rules. Prefer this over rg/grep when the target is syntax shape rather than text; use rg for string contents, comments, filenames, or regex-style byte searches.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按代码结构查找并批量改写代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常常要成批改动代码或统一代码风格。
copy.tagline_en: Find code by syntax shape and rewrite it in bulk.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you routinely refactor code patterns across many files.

howto.what: 遇到按代码结构找代码或改代码的任务时,会用 ast-grep 按语法树匹配:先验证模式,默认只预览,确认后才批量改文件;汇报命中数和影响文件数,也支持运行 YAML 规则。
howto.when: 当任务涉及代码的结构形状(如找所有接收 Request 参数的函数)或做机械改写(如 console.log 换成 logger.info)时触发;只搜字符串、注释、文件名时不触发。

say.text: 把仓库里所有 console.log(x) 改成 logger.info(x)
say.note: 它会先验证模式并预览改动,确认后才实际改。

say.text: 找出所有接收 Request 参数的函数并列出文件
say.note: 会列出函数所在文件和位置。

say.text: 用 YAML lint 规则扫描项目并报告违规
say.note: 会运行 scan 子命令并汇总违规。

howto.what_en: Uses ast-grep to match by syntax tree for structure-based code search and rewrite: validates patterns first, defaults to dry-run, edits only after confirmation; reports affected files and supports YAML rules.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the target is a code shape (e.g. functions taking a Request parameter) or a deterministic rewrite (e.g. console.log to logger.info). Not for searching strings, comments, or filenames.

say_en.text: Rewrite every console.log(x) to logger.info(x) in the repo.
say_en.note: It validates the pattern and previews before applying.

say_en.text: Find all functions that take a Request parameter and list their files.
say_en.note: Returns file locations of matching functions.

say_en.text: Scan the project with the YAML lint rules and report violations.
